payload.artist_html: A. E. Fernandes, O. Mateus, B. Andres, M. J. Polcyn, A. S. Schulp, A. O. Gonçalves, & L. L. Jacobs
payload.credit_html: Pterosaurs from the Late Cretaceous of Angola
payload.description_html: Epapatelo otyikokolo holotype (MGUAN-PA650), left ulna. A) proximal, (B) posterior, (C) distal, (D) dorsal, (E) anterior, and (F) ventral views. Abbreviations: AC, anterior cotyle; B, bump; BT, biceps tubercle; F, fovea; FTG, flexor tendon groove; MS, muscle scar; OP, olecranon process; PC, posterior cotyle; PF, pneumatic foramen; and UT, ulnar tubercle; IMS, interosseous membrane scar; VP, ventral process.
